sentences.text: Itaboravis was an extinct genus of land birds.
Fossils were found in the Early Eocene Itaboraí Formation near São José do Itaboraí in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
The fossil record includes a left coracoid, which is the holotype, and both humeri.
Itaboravis is tentatively classified within the group Cariamae based on similarities to the genus Elaphrocnemus.
Researchers noted morphological similarities in the humerus that link Itaboravis to the family Tinamidae.
Itaboravis lived during the Ypresian stage of the Early Eocene, between 56 and 48.07 million years ago.
